title: Fix LSP server types import for pygls 1.x
description: VSCode Extension CI fails because tactus_lsp_server imports types/constants from pygls.lsp.types, which is not present in pygls 1.3.x. Switch to lsprotocol.types and ensure lsprotocol is an explicit dependency.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_acceptance_criteria: - VSCode Extension CI job 'Test LSP server can start' passes on main\n- tactus-lsp-server imports cleanly with pygls 1.3.x
custom.beads_close_reason: Updated tactus-lsp-server to use lsprotocol.types and declared lsprotocol dependency; VSCode Extension CI LSP start step now passes.
